# Recreation Prompt

Recreate the browser game as a single self-contained mobile-first HTML canvas game titled Starforged Bounty Hex. Preserve the source abstract hex duel exactly: radius-3 axial board, six player and six AI pieces, pointer selection, legal destination highlights, no move may create three allied pieces in a row, pieces surrounded by three or more adjacent enemies are removed after each turn, AI responds after a short delay, and either side loses when reduced to two pieces. Rebuild presentation as a medieval space-bounty fantasy with a crowned star bounty hunter, void knight warrants, castle-in-orbit background, wanted-writ UI, anime-style glowing ki auras, catalog-backed fonts/audio/GIF feedback, and readable portrait-mobile controls.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Current implemented game identity
- genre: mobile-first abstract hex-board tactical duel.
- objective: move allied pieces to surround and remove enemy pieces until the opponent has 2 remaining.
- input model: pointer/tap selects one player piece, highlights legal hexes, then pointer/tap on a highlighted hex moves it.
- core loop: player move, capture check, count update, AI move, capture check, count update, repeat until one side reaches 2 pieces.
- fail/friction state: illegal path or three-in-a-row self-line is rejected with feedback; loss occurs when player pieces drop to 2.

## Protected mechanics
- Radius-3 axial hex board with the same starting coordinates and six pieces per side.
- Same click/tap selection, legal-move highlighting, and move execution semantics.
- Same rule forbidding a move that ends with 3 allied pieces in a straight hex axis.
- Same capture rule: any piece with 3 or more adjacent enemies is removed after a turn.
- Same AI turn timing and heuristic style, same win/loss threshold at 2 remaining pieces, same restart loop.

## Remixed target
A deterministic medieval space-bounty-hunter duel where a starforged hunter commands glowing sigils over a castle-in-orbit contract board against void knights. Presentation, HUD language, sprites, scene ownership, feedback, fonts, and media framing are rebuilt while tactical rules are preserved.
